## Ectoshade (CR 3)

This bluish, misty outline of a man is blurred and vague, though undoubtedly presents a decrepit figure contorted in fear and rage.  


**XP** 800  
CE Medium undead (incorporeal)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+2 deflection, +3 Dex, +1 dodge)  
**hp** 50 (5d8+10)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +4, **Will** +7  
**Defensive Abilities** incorporeal; **Immune** undead traits  
**Weaknesses** partial incorporeality  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 40 ft. (good)  
**Melee** incorporeal touch +7 (3d6)  
**Special Attacks** frightful scream (DC 14)  


**Statistics**


Str—, **Dex** 17, Con—, **Int** 6, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 19  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Iron Will, Weapon Focus (touch)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Fly +15, Perception +9  
**Languages** Common  


**Special Abilities**


**Frightful Scream (Su)** As a standard action, an ectoshade can let out a blood-curdling scream, increasing the fear level of every creature in a 30 ft. cone by one. Creatures without any previous fear condition become shaken, shaken creatures become frightened, frightened creatures become panicked and panicked creatures become cowering, unless they succeed at a DC 14 Will save. Cowering creatures are unaffected. This is a sonic mind-affecting fear effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Partial Incorporeality (Ex)** Corporeal spells and effects that do not cause damage have a 100% chance of affecting the ectoshade, not the 50% common to incorporeal creatures. When hit by spells and magic weapons, it takes full damage instead of half. Nonmagical melee attacks can damage an ectoshade, although they deal only half of normal damage and have a 50% miss chance. Ranged attacks are unaffected by this weakness, and ectoshades count as fully incorporeal against ranged attacks.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary, pair, haunting (3–7), or swarm (8–15)  
**Treasure** incidental
